name: andon
description: Pull the cord on a false "done": a claim-check Stop hook, an auto-orient memory hook, wrap/orient commands and a log-mistake skill.

interface.shortDescription: Catch a false "done" before it reaches you
interface.longDescription: A Stop hook that warns when the agent's final message claims work is done without a fresh verification record, a UserPromptSubmit hook that loads memory/MEMORY.md once per session, the wrap and orient commands (Codex turns commands/*.md into skills), and a log-mistake skill.
defaultPrompt: Orient: read memory/MEMORY.md and tell me where things stand
